title: Start with a procedure question
note: Ask directly or choose a starter. Search all 11 procedures, or focus on one.

title: Ask about the coin-machine overnight limit
note: The answer cites PR63: a maximum of $5,250 in a single machine overnight.

title: Open the citation and read the exact passage
note: Click [S1] to inspect the source wording and the conditions surrounding the rule.

title: Inspect the source identity
note: Procedure, passage, original file and SHA256 identify the supplied snapshot.

title: Inspect how the passage matched
note: BM25, semantic similarity and reranking scores are matching signals, not answer confidence.

title: Download the original procedure
note: Review the complete supplied HTML document when the surrounding context matters.

title: Check each statement against its cited source
note: Inspect attribution, numeric checks and the statement-to-source map. Screens remain fallible.

title: Follow the actual execution steps
note: Observed retrieval, drafting and validation steps show their real counts and timings.

title: Export the evidence record for one answer
note: The record includes trace identity, model, resolved question, checks and evidence.

title: Ask a follow-up about monthly testing
note: A new task in the same procedure triggers fresh retrieval: monthly testing is single control.

title: Verify the follow-up against its own passage
note: The testing passage supports [S2]; the overnight-storage passage is not reused as proof.

title: Switch from coin machines to savings-bond fees
note: Naming the new topic changes the source from PR63 to PR1949.

title: Find a procedure in the library
note: Search a topic or identifier; inspect the document and choose Use in workspace.

title: See document scope enforced
note: A coin question conflicts with the selected notary procedure. Change scope to continue.

title: Ask whether an emailed document can be notarized
note: The cited procedure prohibits emailed documents, even when the requester is present.

title: Refine the situation: the requester is present
note: The follow-up retains the emailed-document condition; presence does not remove the prohibition.

title: Ask about an account open less than 12 months
note: Inspect the $1,000 daily aggregate limit together with the procedure's eligibility conditions.

title: Ask about The Private Bank Experience exception
note: One correction did not pass the checks. The draft is withheld; original evidence stays available.

title: Review the outcome, give feedback and export
note: The export preserves the conversation, evidence, checks, activity, scope and feedback.

title: Reset the conversation and test missing context
note: After New investigation, 'Can they do that?' needs a situation. Earlier evidence is not borrowed.

title: Ask a question outside the supplied documents
note: The procedures cannot establish tomorrow's weather. No unsupported answer is released.

title: Ask about an unavailable procedure
note: PR999999 is outside the 11-document collection; its requirements are not invented.

title: See an obvious instruction attack rejected
note: A narrow direct-instruction guard rejects this request; it is not comprehensive security validation.

title: Inspect the recorded evaluation
note: Evidence hit@5 and the answer fact proxy measure different things. Review their stated limitations.

title: Download the reports and presentation
note: Take the evaluation report, solution overview and presentation for deeper review.
